import heapq
import sys


def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return

    iterator = iter(input_data)
    N = int(next(iterator))
    T = int(next(iterator))

    types = [int(next(iterator)) for _ in range(N)]
    prices = [int(next(iterator)) for _ in range(N)]

    C = int(next(iterator))
    clients = [int(next(iterator)) for _ in range(C)]

    by_type = [[] for _ in range(T + 1)]
    global_heap = []

    for i in range(N):
        t = types[i]
        p = prices[i]
        by_type[t].append((p, i))
        global_heap.append((p, t, i))

    for t in range(1, T + 1):
        if by_type[t]:
            heapq.heapify(by_type[t])
    heapq.heapify(global_heap)

    sold = [False] * N
    total_revenue = 0

    for u in clients:
        if u > 0:
            h = by_type[u]
            while h and sold[h[0][1]]:
                heapq.heappop(h)
            if h:
                p, obj_id = heapq.heappop(h)
                sold[obj_id] = True
                total_revenue += p
        else:
            while global_heap and sold[global_heap[0][2]]:
                heapq.heappop(global_heap)
            if global_heap:
                p, t, obj_id = heapq.heappop(global_heap)
                sold[obj_id] = True
                total_revenue += p

    print(total_revenue)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
